SFAcousticFeature.doc: The value of a voice analysis metric.

SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest.doc: A request to recognize speech from captured audio content, such as audio from the device’s microphone.

SFSpeechLanguageModel.doc: A language model built from custom training data.

SFSpeechLanguageModelConfiguration.doc: An object describing the location of a custom language model and specialized vocabulary.

SFSpeechRecognitionMetadata.doc: The metadata of speech in the audio of a speech recognition request.

SFSpeechRecognitionRequest.doc: An abstract class that represents a request to recognize speech from an audio source.

SFSpeechRecognitionResult.doc: An object that contains the partial or final results of a speech recognition request.

SFSpeechRecognitionTask.doc: A task object for monitoring the speech recognition progress.

SFSpeechRecognizer.doc: An object you use to check for the availability of the speech recognition service, and to initiate the speech recognition process.

SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest.doc: A request to recognize speech in a recorded audio file.

SFTranscription.doc: A textual representation of the specified speech in its entirety, as recognized by the speech recognizer.

SFTranscriptionSegment.doc: A discrete part of an entire transcription, as identified by the speech recognizer.

SFVoiceAnalytics.doc: A collection of vocal analysis metrics.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskDelegate.doc: A protocol with methods for managing multi-utterance speech recognition requests.

SFSpeechRecognizerDelegate.doc: A protocol that you adopt in your objects to track the availability of a speech recognizer.

SFSpeechErrorCode.doc: Error codes that can be thrown under the Speech framework’s error domain.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskHint.doc: The type of task for which you are using speech recognition.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskHintConfirmation.doc: A task that uses captured speech for short, confirmation-style requests.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskHintDictation.doc: A task that uses captured speech for text entry.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskHintSearch.doc: A task that uses captured speech to specify search terms.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskState.doc: The state of the task associated with the recognition request.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskStateCanceling.doc: Delivery of recognition results has finished, but audio recording may be ongoing.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskStateCompleted.doc: Delivery of recognition requests has finished and audio recording has stopped.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskStateFinishing.doc: Audio recording has stopped, but delivery of recognition results may continue.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskStateRunning.doc: Speech recognition (potentially including audio recording) is in progress.

SFSpeechRecognitionTaskStateStarting.doc: Speech recognition (potentially including audio recording) has not yet started.

SFSpeechRecognizerAuthorizationStatus.doc: The app’s authorization to perform speech recognition.

SFSpeechRecognizerAuthorizationStatusAut.doc: The user granted your app’s request to perform speech recognition.

SFSpeechRecognizerAuthorizationStatusDen.doc: The user denied your app’s request to perform speech recognition.

SFSpeechRecognizerAuthorizationStatusNot.doc: The app’s authorization status has not yet been determined.

SFSpeechRecognizerAuthorizationStatusRes.doc: The device prevents your app from performing speech recognition.

-appendAudioPCMBuffer:.doc: Appends audio in the PCM format to the end of the recognition request.

-appendAudioSampleBuffer:.doc: Appends audio to the end of the recognition request.

-endAudio.doc: Marks the end of audio input for the recognition request.

+prepareCustomLanguageModelForUrl:config.doc: Creates a language model from custom training data.
Creates a language model from custom training data.

-cancel.doc: Cancels the current speech recognition task.

-finish.doc: Stops accepting new audio and finishes processing on the audio input that has already been accepted.

+authorizationStatus.doc: Returns your app’s current authorization to perform speech recognition.

+requestAuthorization:.doc: Asks the user to allow your app to perform speech recognition.

+supportedLocales.doc: Returns the set of locales that are supported by the speech recognizer.

-init.doc: Creates a speech recognizer associated with the user’s default language settings.

-initWithLocale:.doc: Creates a speech recognizer associated with the specified locale.

-recognitionTaskWithRequest:delegate:.doc: Recognizes speech from the audio source associated with the specified request, using the specified delegate to manage the results.

-recognitionTaskWithRequest:resultHandle.doc: Executes the speech recognition request and delivers the results to the specified handler block.

-initWithURL:.doc: Creates a speech recognition request, initialized with the specified URL.

acousticFeatureValuePerFrame.doc: An array of feature values, one value per audio frame, corresponding to a transcript segment of recorded audio.

frameDuration.doc: The duration of the audio frame.

nativeAudioFormat.doc: The preferred audio format for optimal speech recognition.

SFSpeechLanguageModelConfiguration.doc: An object describing the location of a custom language model and specialized vocabulary.

averagePauseDuration.doc: The average pause duration between words, measured in seconds.

speakingRate.doc: The number of words spoken per minute.

speechDuration.doc: The duration in seconds of speech in the audio.

speechStartTimestamp.doc: The start timestamp of speech in the audio.

voiceAnalytics.doc: An analysis of the transcription segment’s vocal properties.

addsPunctuation.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to add punctuation to speech recognition results.

contextualStrings.doc: An array of phrases that should be recognized, even if they are not in the system vocabulary.

interactionIdentifier.doc: An identifier string that you use to describe the type of interaction associated with the speech recognition request.

requiresOnDeviceRecognition.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether a request must keep its audio data on the device.

shouldReportPartialResults.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you want intermediate results returned for each utterance.

taskHint.doc: A value that indicates the type of speech recognition being performed.

bestTranscription.doc: The transcription with the highest confidence level.

final.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether speech recognition is complete and whether the transcriptions are final.

speechRecognitionMetadata.doc: An object that contains the metadata results for a speech recognition request.

transcriptions.doc: An array of potential transcriptions, sorted in descending order of confidence.

cancelled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the speech recognition task was canceled.

error.doc: An error object that specifies the error that occurred during a speech recognition task.

finishing.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether audio input has stopped.

state.doc: The current state of the speech recognition task.

available.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the speech recognizer is currently available.

defaultTaskHint.doc: A hint that indicates the type of speech recognition being requested.

delegate.doc: The delegate object that handles changes to the availability of speech recognition services.

locale.doc: The locale of the speech recognizer.

queue.doc: The queue on which to execute recognition task handlers and delegate methods.

supportsOnDeviceRecognition.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the speech recognizer can operate without network access.

URL.doc: The URL of the audio file.

averagePauseDuration.doc: The average pause duration between words, measured in seconds.

formattedString.doc: The entire transcription of utterances, formatted into a single, user-displayable string.

segments.doc: An array of transcription segments that represent the parts of the transcription, as identified by the speech recognizer.

speakingRate.doc: The number of words spoken per minute.

alternativeSubstrings.doc: An array of alternate interpretations of the utterance in the transcription segment.

confidence.doc: The level of confidence the speech recognizer has in its recognition of the speech transcribed for the segment.

duration.doc: The number of seconds it took for the user to speak the utterance represented by the segment.

substring.doc: The string representation of the utterance in the transcription segment.

substringRange.doc: The range information for the transcription segment’s substring, relative to the overall transcription.

timestamp.doc: The start time of the segment in the processed audio stream.

voiceAnalytics.doc: An analysis of the transcription segment’s vocal properties.

jitter.doc: The variation in pitch in each frame of a transcription segment, expressed as a percentage of the frame’s fundamental frequency.

pitch.doc: The highness or lowness of the tone (fundamental frequency) in each frame of a transcription segment, expressed as a logarithm.

shimmer.doc: The variation in vocal volume stability (amplitude) in each frame of a transcription segment, expressed in decibels.

voicing.doc: The likelihood of a voice in each frame of a transcription segment.
